summary: ANGLE_VERSION=2 angle-view regeneration fix verified end-to-end. Backend 8/8 pytest pass. Vintage Milgrain emerald engagement ring: fresh v2 angle generations for front/side/top all succeed (~15-25s each), each returns cached=true on the second POST, and GET /api/renders/{h}/angles/{angle} returns null for the stale v1 cache (proven by inserting a doc with v:1 directly into render_angles and verifying the endpoint still returns image_url:null). Visual inspection of the four generated images against the user's reported bug: (1) TOP view keeps the centre stone perfectly ROUND (no oval drift), (2) FRONT view shows the ring upright with the head sitting on the band (no floating / impossible loop), (3) SIDE view is a correct 90-degree profile with the shank seen edge-on and the full head height + gallery visible, (4) all three preserve the hallmark Vintage Milgrain details — round emerald, gold milgrain-edged halo, filigree gallery/basket, polished band. Regression: 4-Prong Solitaire angle generation + caching still works. render_service.design_facts() returns a 'Subject:'-prefixed ground-truth spec with the camera-framing phrases stripped, as intended. Frontend web preview (/build desktop 1440x900) loads cleanly, Bridal -> Engagement Ring -> Vintage Milgrain selectable, caption shows 'Vintage Milgrain Engagement Ring · 18k Yellow Gold', and the testIDs render-status, builder-preview-canvas, canvas-mode-toggle, builder-render-photo, canvas-mode-photo and the angle-bar labels (¾/Front/Side/Top/Back) are all present. No red screens or console errors. 6 AI generations consumed in total (within the ~6 budget).
action_items: No functional changes required — the fix is working as designed. Optional nit: in design-canvas.tsx pickAngle(), when the user re-selects a non-hero angle after a new render (render.id changes), angleUrls is cleared by the useEffect on key change, but if the stale URL is still rendered via shownUrl between the clear and the next fetch there is a tiny flicker; low priority.
critical_code_review_comments: render_service.ANGLE_VERSION=2 is read dynamically by both the GET and POST handlers; bumping the constant will correctly invalidate cached v1 rows without a migration (verified in test_angle_version_rejects_v1_cache).

generate_angle() correctly detects ring vs non-ring from the facts string prefix to decide whether to inject ANGLE_RULES (the physical-anatomy sentence). Edge case: fashion-ring / pendant / tennis facts don't start with 'engagement ring' and don't contain ' ring in '/'wedding band' in first 80 chars, so ANGLE_RULES is applied only when facts is empty — that's a reasonable fallback.
design_facts() strips the three framing sentences and the final 'Only the jewelry…' line. The output starts with 'Subject:' and preserves setting/band/stone details — verified.

server.create_angle() catches a failure in design_facts (if the design options schema changed since the render) and falls back to facts='' — angles then rely on the photo alone, which is the safe behaviour.
No MongoDB _id leaks in /api/renders/{h}/angles payloads; only image_url and cached are returned.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create two TEST_ renders (Vintage Milgrain emerald + 4-Prong Solitaire) and their angle rows in the gado tenant. Hashes are deterministic on the design spec so re-runs reuse the same render docs (no sprawl). Also inserts and immediately deletes one synthetic v1 render_angles doc to verify version filtering.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-run: export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL + MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 + DB_NAME=test_database, then `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_render_angles_v2.py -v -s`. Generated angle PNGs are saved to /app/test_reports/angle_images/ for human review. If ANGLE_VERSION is bumped again, the test_angle_version_rejects_v1_cache test will need to be updated to insert a doc with v:(ANGLE_VERSION-1) rather than hard-coded v:1.
rca_of_issue: N/A — the main agent's fix (passing design_facts() as ground truth into generate_angle(), redefining ANGLES with explicit camera geometry, adding ANGLE_RULES for ring anatomy, and versioning the cache with ANGLE_VERSION=2) is correctly implemented and visually produces round stones in TOP view and physically plausible bands in FRONT view for the Vintage Milgrain emerald design the user reported.
